text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
—Now then,
today we'll be holding mock races split into
groups! We're halfway through camp,
so make sure to test the fruits of your
training thoroughly!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Cesario-san.
It seems we are in the same group.
...I look forward to competing with you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Your razor-sharp stride has already earned
high praise from the trainers.
I intend to experience it firsthand with
every fiber of my being.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You speak with such modest grace.
Yet judging by that gaze of yours,
you clearly have no intention of merely
'experiencing' it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
However, my resolve is the same.
With this very blade of mine—
I shall cut through you.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
Cesario-san's presence is crazy
intense...!
I'm so glad I'm not in their group~...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Messiah-san staying totally calm while facing
that down is pretty insane too, though.
Well, when it comes to the actual race,
though—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the mock race began.
Air Messiah maintained a cool,
composed pace throughout,
properly conserving her stamina until the
final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Now—! Haaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing an opening ahead,
Air Messiah bursts into her final spurt.
Her closing kick is remarkably sharp.
She steadily closes the gap on the leader!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Wait,
Cesario-san is... boxed in near the back!?
Whoa, she has nowhere to go!
There's no way she can make it from
there...!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaahhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—In that split second,
threading through the pack,
Cesario surges forward with a terrifying
burst of speed...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! Guh—!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
No way... No, no,
no way!
How could she pull that off from that far
back—?!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*...!
...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When it was all said and done...
Cesario crossed the line first.
Air Messiah took second,
finishing a length behind.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Insaaanely good... Cesario-san's just unreal,
huh...
Talk about out-of-this-world talent,
seriously...

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Guy
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, pal!
Hm...
What's up?
Did little Messiah lose her race?
choice_data_list: Yeah, she was just one step away, ...

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Guy
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, miss!
Hm...
What's up?
Did little Messiah lose her race?
choice_data_list: Yeah, she was just one step away, ...

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Guy
text_block_list.text:
Just a hair shy,
huh... She must be pretty bummed out.
Especially considering everything with her
mom and all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she always seemed so calm,
her brows were now knit tight in
frustration.
Her tightly pressed lips appeared to be
trembling ever so slightly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had put in the work. Seriously,
steadfastly,
executing everything she had to do.
And yet, faced with overwhelming raw talent,
she fell just short in defeat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are realms that 'just trying hard and
playing by the book' can never quite
reach—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Mother, how does it look?
Is there anything amiss with the way I'm
wearing it?

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
It's perfect, dear.
It fits you beautifully and looks wonderful
on you. ...Tomorrow,
you'll finally be a Tracen Academy
student.

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Listen to me... Don't push yourself too hard,
okay?
Being a hard worker is admirable,
but please take good care of your health
above all else.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Mother.
Taking every one of your teachings to heart,
I will give this my absolute all.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Um, also...
May I make one selfish request?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
To reaffirm my own resolve...
I would like to watch your Triple Tiara
races again.

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Yes, of course that's fine, but...
...Is that really all you want to ask for?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. That is all.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Mother. ...With that alone, I—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day after the mock race—a downpour.

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
The sea's getting pretty rough too...
Training is definitely called off for
today.
You should take it easy too.
In spite of the dreary weather, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With training cancelled for the day and no
chores left to do,
I spent some time idling about the training
lodge, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Restless and unable to settle down,
before I knew it, I had walked over to
a nearby bookstore to browse for references
that might help with training.
choice_data_list: (Ah, this is that new release I wa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'd heard it was popular,
but there was still a single copy left on
the shelf.
Taking advantage of the lucky break,
I reached out—only to...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my apologies.
Um...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
You reached for it first, so please,
go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't possibly take it over her.
A little forcefully,
I picked up the book and held it out directly
toward her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah hesitated for a brief moment,
but
before long—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I understand.
In that case,
I will gladly accept your kindness.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
In return... let's see.
Um, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Would it be possible for us to meet again
tomorrow evening, after training?
